subject: Ordered =TRUE, robust indices not NAs for configural and metric models

messages.author: 580c1540ff71f5be
messages.subject: Ordered =TRUE, robust indices not NAs for configural and metric models
parts:
Dear all, 

I have 2 questions regarding the use of ordered = TRUE in combination with missing = pairwise.
1. Robust indices (robust RMSEA, robust CFI...) are calculated for configural and metric invariance but not for scalar or residual. I thought robust indices would not be computed as I am using "ordered = TRUE", and there would be NAs. Is this normal? These are the models:
Configural model : cfa (specified_model, data = dataset, sampling.weights = "wgt", std.lv = F, meanstructure = T, ordered = TRUE, missing = "pairwise",
                       group = "country")
Metric model: cfa (specified_model, data = dataset, sampling.weights = "wgt", std.lv = F, meanstructure = T, ordered = TRUE, missing = "pairwise",
                       group = "country",
                       group.equal = "loadings")
Scalar model: cfa (specified_model, data = dataset, sampling.weights = "wgt", std.lv = F, meanstructure = T, ordered = TRUE, missing = "pairwise",
                       group = "country",
                       group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"))
Residual model: cfa (specified_model, data = dataset, sampling.weights = "wgt", std.lv = F, meanstructure = T, ordered = TRUE, missing = "pairwise",
                       group = "country",
                       group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts", "residuals"))

2. Which indices should be reported when using ordered = TRUE and missing = pairwise? Should this be the robust indices? And if not, should it be the Standard or the Scaled ones? 

Thank you in advance. 

A.
